title: Reflected long annotation members compile in generated Java
summary: The generated long annotation compiled and reflected back as 12345678910. Reflection on a compiled long array also preserved the negative out-of-int-range element and its position.

change.description: JavaPoet appends a long literal suffix when serializing a reflected annotation member of type long.

notes: Reflecting on the compiled consumer checks the literal type, element order and sign independently of source formatting.
